import hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
assert os.environ.get('EOS_CPU_IDS'), 'ExperimentOS CPU lease required'
R=Path('/pub/data/jiafq/xolver');V=R/'validation/arithmetic-r103'
O=Path(sys.argv[1]);O.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'tools/fuzz'))
from fuzz_theory_applications import parse,emit,replay
B=V/'core-r140/xolver';Z=R/'dependencies/oracles/z3-5.3.2';C=R/'dependencies/oracles/cvc5'
files=sorted((R/'tests/regression/lia').glob('*remainder*.smt2'))
files=[p for p in files if p.name in ['lia_divisible_remainder_prefix_unsat.smt2','lia_divisible_remainder_negative_sat.smt2','lia_incomparable_remainders_sat.smt2','lia_large_divisible_remainder_unsat.smt2']]
files += [R/'tests/regression/nia/nia_divisible_remainder_prefix_unsat.smt2']
assert len(files)==5
def call(label,cmd):
 start=time.monotonic()
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(['prlimit','--as='+str(16*1024**3),'--',*cmd],cwd=R,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
  stdout,stderr=p.stdout,p.stderr;rc=p.returncode
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  stdout,stderr='', 'external timeout';rc=124
 (O/(label+'.stdout')).write_text(stdout);(O/(label+'.stderr')).write_text(stderr)
 verdict=re.findall(r'^(sat|unsat|unknown)\s*$',stdout,re.M)
 return {'command':cmd,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'rc':rc,'result':verdict[0] if rc==0 and len(verdict)==1 else 'unresolved'}
rows=[];wrong=0;unconfirmed=0
for i,path in enumerate(files):
 source=path.read_text();expected=re.search(r':status\s+(sat|unsat)',source).group(1)
 row={'file':str(path.relative_to(R)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'expected':expected,'checks':{}}
 commands={'xolver':[str(B),'solve'],'z3':[str(Z),'-T:60'],'cvc5':[str(C),'--lang=smt2','--tlimit=60000']}
 for name,command in commands.items():
  row['checks'][name]=call(str(i)+'-'+name,[*command,str(path),*(['--timeout','60'] if name=='xolver' else [])])
 results={a['result'] for a in row['checks'].values()}
 bad=(row['checks']['xolver']['result']!=expected or bool(({'sat','unsat'}-{expected}) & results))
 confirmed=any(row['checks'][n]['result']==expected for n in ['z3','cvc5'])
 if expected=='sat' and not bad:
  prefix='\n'.join(emit(c) for c in parse(source) if emit(c[0]) not in ('check-sat','get-model','exit','set-info','set-option'))
  query=O/(str(i)+'-model.smt2');query.write_text('(set-option :produce-models true)\n'+prefix+'\n(check-sat)\n(get-model)\n')
  row['model']=call(str(i)+'-model',[str(B),'solve',str(query),'--timeout','60'])
  pinned=O/(str(i)+'-replay.smt2');pinned.write_text(replay(prefix,(O/(str(i)+'-model.stdout')).read_text()))
  row['replays']={n:call(str(i)+'-replay-'+n,[*commands[n],str(pinned)]) for n in ['z3','cvc5']}
  bad |= row['model']['result']!='sat' or any(c['result']=='unsat' for c in row['replays'].values())
  confirmed &= any(c['result']=='sat' for c in row['replays'].values())
 row['wrong']=bad;row['confirmed']=bool(confirmed and not bad);rows.append(row)
 wrong+=bool(bad);unconfirmed+=not row['confirmed']
report={'rows':rows,'binaries':{n:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n,p in [('xolver',B),('z3',Z),('cvc5',C)]},'wrong':wrong,'unconfirmed':unconfirmed}
(O/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert wrong==0 and unconfirmed==0,report
